instruction: Configure Apache WebDAV with SSL
output:
sudo a2enmod ssl && sudo a2ensite default-ssl && echo 'Alias /webdav /var/www/webdav
<Directory /var/www/webdav>
    DAV On
    SSLRequireSSL
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/webdav-ssl.conf && sudo a2enconf webdav-ssl && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Check which DAV methods are allowed on the server
output: curl -X OPTIONS http://localhost/webdav/ -I --user alice:secretpass | grep Allow

instruction: Install ownCloud from tarball and set permissions
output: cd /tmp && wget https://download.owncloud.org/community/owncloud-10.15.0.tar.bz2 && sudo tar -xjf owncloud-10.15.0.tar.bz2 -C /var/www/ && sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/owncloud

instruction: Configure ownCloud database with occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ maintenance:install --database pgsql --database-name owncloud --database-user owncloud --database-pass owncloudpass --admin-user admin --admin-pass admin123

instruction: List ownCloud apps with occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ app:list

instruction: Enable encryption in ownCloud via occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ encryption:enable

instruction: Disable encryption in ownCloud via occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ encryption:disable

instruction: View ownCloud encryption status via occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ encryption:status

instruction: Add user to group in Nextcloud via occ
output: sudo -u www-data nextcloud.occ group:adduser staff dave

instruction: Remove user from group in Nextcloud via occ
output: sudo -u www-data nextcloud.occ group:removeuser staff dave

instruction: Delete Nextcloud group via occ
output: sudo -u www-data nextcloud.occ group:delete oldgroup

instruction: List Nextcloud users with occ
output: sudo -u www-data nextcloud.occ user:list

instruction: Report WebDAV quota usage with curl and PROPFIND
output: curl -X PROPFIND http://localhost/webdav/ --user alice:secretpass -H 'Depth: 0' -H 'Content-Type: text/xml' -d '<?xml version="1.0"?><D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:prop><D:quota-available-bytes/><D:quota-used-bytes/></D:prop></D:propfind>'

instruction: Set custom WebDAV property with PROPPATCH
output: curl -X PROPPATCH http://localhost/webdav/note.txt --user alice:secretpass -H 'Content-Type: text/xml' -d '<D:propertyupdate xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:set><D:prop><my:custom xmlns:my="http://example.com/">value</my:custom></D:prop></D:set></D:propertyupdate>'

instruction: Lock a WebDAV resource with timeout
output: curl -X LOCK http://localhost/webdav/edit.txt --user alice:secretpass -H 'Content-Type: text/xml' -H 'Timeout: Infinite-Second' -d '<D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:shared/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype><D:owner><D:href>alice</D:href></D:owner></D:lockinfo>'

instruction: Refresh WebDAV lock with new timeout
output: curl -X LOCK http://localhost/webdav/edit.txt --user alice:secretpass -H 'Content-Type: text/xml' -H 'If: <urn:uuid:locktoken>' -d '<D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:shared/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype></D:lockinfo>'

instruction: Perform COPY with depth infinity
output: curl -X COPY http://localhost/webdav/srcdir/ --header 'Destination: http://localhost/webdav/destdir/' --header 'Depth: Infinity' --user alice:secretpass

instruction: Move a WebDAV directory with depth infinity
output: curl -X MOVE http://localhost/webdav/olddir/ --header 'Destination: http://localhost/webdav/newdir/' --header 'Depth: Infinity' --user alice:secretpass

instruction: cadaver command to view remote file line by line
output: cadaver http://localhost/webdav/ <<< 'cat log.txt'

instruction: Check if wsgiDAV is running
output: ps aux | grep wsgidav

instruction: Install the litmus WebDAV test suite from source
output: sudo apt install build-essential && cd /tmp && git clone https://github.com/neil-lindquist/litmus.git && cd litmus && ./configure && make && sudo make install

instruction: Test WebDAV server with curl for Basic auth
output: curl -u alice:secretpass http://localhost/webdav/ -X PROPFIND -H 'Depth: 0'
